PYPROJECT = """
[project.scripts]
mycli = \"my_package.cli:run_app\"
analyze = \"my_package.tools.analyze:main\"
serve = \"my_package.server:start\"
"""


def unresolved_entrypoint(script_target: str) -> bool:
    module, _, attr = script_target.partition(":")
    return module.endswith(".cli") and attr == "run_app"
